# Status & alias files — where does this go?

A quick-reference map of every file involved in building the combined component status
table. For the deeper story on the RSP/SWC status vocabulary itself — what `stable`,
`internal`, `preview`, and `deprecated` mean per source, and why they can't be merged
directly — see [DATA-CONTRACT.md](./DATA-CONTRACT.md). This doc is the map; that one is
the contract.

Everything here is produced by one script, [`deps/build-status-index.js`](../build-status-index.js),
run by the daily GitHub Action after the per-implementation extractions. It reads the
hand-authored inputs below, joins the RSP/SWC/Figma rosters, resolves each cell's status,
and writes the generated outputs below. Nothing downstream should read raw RSP/SWC/Figma
data directly — everything binds to the generated files.

```
hand-authored inputs                                    generated outputs
─────────────────────                                    ─────────────────
component-aliases.json  ─┐                               deps/status-index.json
status-overrides.json    │                                 (combined table)
roster-excludes.json     ├──►  deps/build-status-index.js
<impl>-secondary-        │     (reads scripts/utils/                       deps/status/<slug>.json
  status.json             │      extraction-status.js +                     (one file per component)
raw extraction data      ─┘      status-model.js)
  (rsp/data, swc/data,                                                     deps/impl-aliases.js
   figma/components.json)                                                    (doc-link redirects)
```

## Where do I put a change?

| I want to... | Edit this file |
| --- | --- |
| Mark a component available/deprecated/experimental by hand, overriding what auto-detection produced | [`deps/status-overrides.json`](../status-overrides.json) |
| Fix a name that doesn't match cleanly across RSP/SWC/Figma (e.g. `swc-asset` isn't RSP's `AssetCard`) | [`deps/component-aliases.json`](../component-aliases.json) |
| Remove a sub-component from the table entirely (it's a composition part, not a standalone component) | [`deps/roster-excludes.json`](../roster-excludes.json) |
| Add a "use Gen1 instead" style note under a status badge | `deps/<impl>/<impl>-secondary-status.json` (or `deps/figma/figma-secondary-status.json`) |
| Change what a raw status value (`stable`, `internal`, `preview`, ...) means in the unified table | [`scripts/utils/status-model.js`](../../scripts/utils/status-model.js) |
| Change how a raw RSP/SWC extraction file's status field is read | [`scripts/utils/extraction-status.js`](../../scripts/utils/extraction-status.js) |

None of the files under "generated outputs" below should ever be hand-edited — each one
starts with `// Generated by deps/build-status-index.js — do not edit by hand.` (or the
JSON-comment equivalent). Run `node deps/build-status-index.js` to regenerate them.

## Full file inventory

### Hand-authored inputs

| File | Keyed by | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`deps/component-aliases.json`](../component-aliases.json) | source (`rsp`/`swc`/`figma`) → that source's own name | Canonical-name resolution for the roster join. Can also carry `externalName` — the name the *source's own public docs* use, when it differs from both the canonical name and the source's own export name (see "Two alias tables" below). |
| [`deps/status-overrides.json`](../status-overrides.json) | canonical name → platform → impl | Manual status override, applied last — wins over anything auto-detected. |
| [`deps/roster-excludes.json`](../roster-excludes.json) | — (flat list) | Canonical names to drop from the joined roster entirely (composition sub-parts). |
| `deps/rsp/rsp-secondary-status.json`, `deps/swc/swc-secondary-status.json`, `deps/figma/figma-secondary-status.json` | canonical name | Per-implementation secondary guidance text shown under the primary status badge. |
| `deps/rsp/data/*.json`, `deps/swc/data/swc-*.json`, `deps/figma/components.json` | — | Raw per-source extraction data (see each implementation's own README + [DATA-CONTRACT.md](./DATA-CONTRACT.md)). |

### Build-time logic

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`deps/build-status-index.js`](../build-status-index.js) | The orchestrator. Joins rosters, resolves statuses, applies secondary guidance then overrides, writes every generated output below. |
| [`scripts/utils/extraction-status.js`](../../scripts/utils/extraction-status.js) | Parses a raw RSP/SWC extraction file's shape (RSP is `{props, status?}`, SWC is a flat prop array) into props + a raw status value. Not the unified vocabulary — just shape-normalization. |
| [`scripts/utils/status-model.js`](../../scripts/utils/status-model.js) | Defines the unified status vocabulary (`STATUSES`: available/experimental/deprecated/removed/not-available) and maps each source's raw status value onto it. |

### Generated outputs (never hand-edit)

| File | Consumed by | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`deps/status-index.json`](../status-index.json) | `blocks/status-table/status-table.js` | The full combined table — every component, every platform/impl cell, plus a self-describing status legend. |
| `deps/status/<slug>.json` (one per component) | `blocks/component-status/component-status.js`, `scripts/utils/figma.js` (via [`scripts/utils/component-slice.js`](../../scripts/utils/component-slice.js)) | One component's cells + Figma node id — a single small fetch instead of downloading and searching the whole index on every component doc page. |
| [`deps/impl-aliases.js`](../impl-aliases.js) | `scripts/utils/go-to-impl.js` | Slug → the name a source's *external docs site* actually uses, for building working doc links (e.g. `AlertDialog` → `Dialog.html`). |

## Naming note

`component-status` used to name three unrelated things — a block
(`blocks/component-status/component-status.js`), a utility (now
`scripts/utils/extraction-status.js`), and the Figma roster file (now
`deps/figma/components.json`, matching `deps/rsp/components.json` /
`deps/swc/components.json`). If you're searching for one of these by that name and land
on the wrong file, this is why the utility and the roster got renamed.
